name: PD 182 was established by Ordinance No. 18390, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 5, 1984. Ordinance No. 18390 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 18390 was amended by Ordinance No. 23362, passed  by the Dallas City Council on December 10, 1997. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18390; 23362; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 182 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 182 was established by Ordinance No. 18390, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 5, 1984. Ordinance No. 18390 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 18390 was amended by Ordinance No. 23362, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 10, 1997. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18390; 23362; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 182 is established on property generally located on Park Lane, east of Shady Brook Lane. The size of PD 182 is approximately 7,713 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 18390; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-182.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.104.CONCEPTUAL PLAN. Development must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 182A). (Ord. Nos. 23362; 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.105.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. For a restaurant without drive-in service and uses requiring a specific use permit in this district, a development plan must be approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of any building permit or certificate of occupancy for these uses on the Property. For all other uses permitted in this PD, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan do not apply. (Ord. Nos. 23362; 25508)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.106.PERMITTED USES. Uses permitted on the Property are those uses permitted in an NS Neighborhood Service District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the NS Neighborhood Service District, as set out in Chapter 51.For example, a use permitted in the NS Neighborhood Service District by specific use permit (SUP) only is permitted in this PD by SUP. A use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the NS Neighborhood Service District is subject to DIR in this PD, etc. (Ord. Nos. 23362; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Permitted Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.107.MAXIMUM PERMITTED HEIGHT. Maximum permitted height for all buildings and structures on the Property is 24 feet. (Ord. Nos. 23362; 25508)

sections.title: Floor Area Ratio
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.108.FLOOR AREA RATIO. Maximum permitted floor area ratio is 0.5 square feet of floor area for each one square foot of land area. (Ord. Nos. 23362; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Lot Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.109.MAXIMUM LOT COVERAGE. Maximum permitted lot coverage for the Property is 40 percent. (Ord. Nos. 23362; 25508)

sections.title: Minimum Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-182.110.MINIMUM SETBACKS. Maximum setbacks for all buildings and structures on the Property are as follows:
(1)Front yard: 25 feet.
(2)Side yard: five feet.
(3)Rear yard: five feet. (Ord. Nos. 23362; 25508)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.111.OFF-STREET PARKING. Consult the use regulations of Chapter 51 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Division 51-4.300) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 23362; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.112.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the non-business sign provisions of Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 23362; 25508)

sections.title: Access
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.113.ACCESS. There must be only one vehicular access to the Property from Park Lane as shown on the conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 23362; 25508)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.114.LANDSCAPING. Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X. All plant material must be maintained in a healthy growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 23362; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.115.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23362; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-182.116.PAVING.
(a)All parking spaces, aisles, maneuvering areas, and driveway connections to streets or alleys, whether enclosed or unenclosed, must be surfaced to comply with the standards set out in Chapter 51.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18390; 23362; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.117.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18390; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-182.118.ZONING MAP. PD 182 is located on Zoning Map No. F-8. (Ord. Nos. 18390; 25508)
